scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible exact-rational finite cross-check. Literature comparisons do not establish exhaustive novelty. No authorship or independent certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: All-vacancy finite-improvement is proved only for complete bipartite graphs with fully strategic agents and occupied-neighbor fractional diversity; the exact two-color equilibrium polynomial does not extend to arbitrary types. Independent validation is not performed.
title: A factorial ordinal potential and equilibrium census for diversity jumps with arbitrary vacancies on complete bipartite graphs
